facts.title: Step-free entry
facts.detail: The museum reports stair-free access at every entrance and exit.

facts.title: Parking
facts.detail: The Smithsonian does not provide parking. Check its accessibility map for designated spaces nearby.

facts.title: Moving between floors
facts.detail: The museum reports elevator access to public floors and wheelchair access to all exhibitions.

facts.title: Borrowing a wheelchair
facts.detail: Manual wheelchairs are free to borrow, first come, first served, for indoor use. Ask at the Evans Gallery Information Desk.

facts.title: Hearing support
facts.detail: Exhibition videos have open captions. Induction loops are at the Rotunda Information Desk and Worldwide Theater.

facts.title: Quieter visit
facts.detail: The museum suggests Monday to Wednesday for a quieter visit, with exceptions for holidays and events.

facts.title: Lift status today
facts.detail: Not checked in this guide. Confirm current operation before travelling.

facts.title: Door widths and turning space
facts.detail: Measurements were not captured for this guide. Ask the museum about your specific route.
